research_question: On entirely new bounded raw dialogues, does an enumerated role-aware source-span evaluator distinguish equivalent evidence boundaries from role or meaning errors, while the unchanged 9B/4B raw-to-typed-spec pipeline still meets every non-span quality, rejection, accounting, and 20-second gate?

role_aware_scoring.eligible_span_rule: The packet must normalize under the unchanged P4-BC contract. It must have exactly the expected three unique roles in the expected order; each atom must be a nonempty exact source substring and equal one of that role's one or two prospectively adjudicated accepted_exact_spans. No generic substring, overlap, trimming, case folding, translation, or normalization is allowed.

template_specific_limit_meaning.write_one_atomic_value: the task is complete after the stated value is entered, not merely that the reply contains one step

role_aware_scoring.non_span_exact_rule: Compare source identity/span, schema, template, safety class, and complete canonical Japanese slots exactly with expected_spec; only evidence text boundary may use the enumerated role-aware span set.
role_aware_scoring.annotation_consistency_proxy: Two LLM-proxy judgments over 54 developer-authored source-exact candidates agree on 48/54 binary labels and 12/18 full role sets. Six disputed candidates are excluded by pre-model intersection. This is neither blind human annotation nor Krippendorff alpha.

selection_rule: A model is eligible only if every P4-BD gate passes; strict single-gold evidence and exact-spec are reported but do not gate this one changed scoring boundary. If both eligible, select lower median call latency, then fewer completion tokens. If neither, preserve both negative results and do not change product runtime.
claim_boundary: A pass would establish only that a prospectively enumerated role-aware evaluator avoids some single-gold boundary false negatives on six developer-authored ontology cases while the unchanged upstream and downstream gates also pass. It would not establish general pragmatic understanding, action usefulness, human preference, matched strong-LLM advantage, or a human equation.
